backup.label: Back up this save
backup.description: Copy the archive and current loose save files to a new backup folder.

try_load.label: Try loading after backup
try_load.description: Open the game yourself and try this save after keeping a backup. The browser does not start the game.

load_older_save.label: Choose another save
load_older_save.description: Inspect an earlier save before deciding which one to load in the game.

send_report.label: Save a report to share
send_report.description: Export the complete report for you to share; nothing is sent automatically.

restore_install.label: Restore matching map files
restore_install.description: Restore map files from the installation used when this save was made, then check again.

reextract.label: Extract a separate copy
reextract.description: Extract the selected archive into a new folder for inspection. Replacing the game's working files is a separate decision.

choose_save.label: Choose a save
choose_save.description: Select an existing archive to inspect.

choose_reference.label: Choose original map files
choose_reference.description: Select a trusted copy of the map files used when this save was created.

PASS.title: No problems found
PASS.meaning: The checks completed without finding an integrity problem. This does not guarantee that the game will load the save successfully.
PASS.load_text: It is reasonable to try loading after making a backup.

WARN.title: Review advised
WARN.meaning: Some evidence is missing or uncertain. The save may still load; read the findings before deciding.
WARN.load_text: Back up first, review the warnings, then decide whether to try loading.

ERROR.title: Integrity errors
ERROR.meaning: One or more checks found a problem that needs attention before loading or overwriting this save.

FATAL.title: Unsafe to load
FATAL.meaning: A required part of the save or its matching map files is missing or broken. Loading could crash the game or damage the saved world.
FATAL.load_text: Do not load or overwrite this save until the problem is resolved.

NO_SAVE_SELECTED.title: No save selected
NO_SAVE_SELECTED.meaning: There is no start.dat selecting a save in this folder. The game can begin a new game; you can choose an existing save to inspect.
NO_SAVE_SELECTED.load_text: There is no selected save to try loading.

self_reference_note: The installed map files were compared with themselves. The map layout used when this save was made has not been verified.

unknown_finding.title: Finding needs review
unknown_finding.meaning: This checker result has no plain explanation yet. Open Details and keep a copy of the report.
unknown_finding.what_to_do: Back up the save and share the report before deciding what to change.
unknown_finding.load_text: Follow the overall loading advice above.

SEL01/FATAL.title: Save selection cannot be read
SEL01/FATAL.meaning: The file that selects the current save is unreadable or damaged.
SEL01/FATAL.what_to_do: Choose an existing save to inspect. Keep a backup before restoring a valid selection file.
SEL01/FATAL.load_text: Do not rely on the current selection until it is fixed.

SEL02/FATAL.title: Save folder is unavailable
SEL02/FATAL.meaning: The requested save folder could not be found.
SEL02/FATAL.what_to_do: Choose the correct installation or a saved archive to inspect.
SEL02/FATAL.load_text: The requested save cannot be checked or loaded from this folder.

ARC01/FATAL.title: Save archive cannot be read
ARC01/FATAL.meaning: The archive for slot {slot} is missing, unreadable, or does not have a valid layout.
ARC01/FATAL.what_to_do: Keep the original and recover a readable copy from backup, or inspect an older save.

ARC10/WARN.title: Unexpected map numbers
ARC10/WARN.meaning: This archive contains {count} maps outside the shipped map range: {maps}. The game accepts these numbers, but their origin is uncertain.
ARC10/WARN.what_to_do: Check where these maps came from before removing or replacing anything.
ARC10/WARN.load_text: These map numbers alone do not make the save unsafe; review and back up first.

CUS01/FATAL.title: Working save state does not match
CUS01/FATAL.meaning: The current working state is missing or differs from slot {slot}'s archive.
CUS01/FATAL.what_to_do: Back up the working files and extract a separate copy of the selected archive to compare.
CUS01/FATAL.load_text: Restore matching working state before loading this selection.

CUS02/FATAL.title: Working map file is missing
CUS02/FATAL.meaning: A map saved in slot {slot} is absent from the working folder: {maps}.
CUS02/FATAL.what_to_do: Recover the missing map from the selected archive after backing up the working folder.
CUS02/FATAL.load_text: Restore the matching map before loading.

CUS03/FATAL.title: Working map does not match this save
CUS03/FATAL.meaning: The working map files differ from slot {slot}'s archive: {maps}.
CUS03/FATAL.what_to_do: Back up first and compare a separate extraction of this archive. Do not mix files from different slots.
CUS03/FATAL.load_text: Restore matching map files before loading this selection.

CUS04/WARN.title: Extra working map file
CUS04/WARN.meaning: The working folder contains maps that are absent from this archive: {maps}. They may be leftovers or may have been created after loading.
CUS04/WARN.what_to_do: Establish where these files came from before changing the working folder.
CUS04/WARN.load_text: Their presence alone does not prove damage; review and back up first.

CUS07/INFO.title: Partial working-file bundle
CUS07/INFO.meaning: This inspection intentionally omits {count} archived working files.
CUS07/INFO.what_to_do: Provide the complete working folder if you need to verify the current selection.
CUS07/INFO.load_text: This limited inspection does not establish that the complete save is ready to load.

NFS01/FATAL.title: Saved map cannot be read
NFS01/FATAL.meaning: A saved map has an unreadable or invalid layout: {maps}.
NFS01/FATAL.what_to_do: Keep the damaged files and recover matching maps from a known good save backup.
NFS01/FATAL.load_text: Do not load this save with the affected maps.

NFS01/WARN.title: Saved map size note differs
NFS01/WARN.meaning: The map's recorded size note ({declared} bytes) differs from its physical size ({actual} bytes): {maps}. The size note is advisory.
NFS01/WARN.what_to_do: Review the size difference; this finding alone does not require repairing the map.
NFS01/WARN.load_text: It is reasonable to try loading after backup if no more serious findings apply.

NFS07/WARN.title: Some saved map objects could not be checked
NFS07/WARN.meaning: The checker could not fully identify used and unused space in {count} map areas: {maps}.
NFS07/WARN.what_to_do: Keep a backup and review the uncertain areas. Objects that could not be classified are not proven damaged or deleted.
NFS07/WARN.load_text: The save may still load; review this warning and any more serious findings first.

FXS01/FATAL.title: Installed map cannot be read
FXS01/FATAL.meaning: An installed map has an invalid layout or is shorter than its recorded size: {maps}.
FXS01/FATAL.what_to_do: Restore intact map files from the installation used when this save was made.
FXS01/FATAL.load_text: Do not load with these damaged installed maps.

FXS04/FATAL.title: Installed map storage is damaged
FXS04/FATAL.meaning: The checker found invalid unused-space lists on {count} pages in the installed maps: {maps}.
FXS04/FATAL.what_to_do: Preserve the maps and restore intact copies matching the save's original installation.
FXS04/FATAL.load_text: Do not load with these map files.

HND01/FATAL.title: Saved object links cannot be read
HND01/FATAL.meaning: The saved table of links to world objects has an invalid layout.
HND01/FATAL.what_to_do: Keep the original and recover matching saved state from backup, or use an older save.
HND01/FATAL.load_text: Do not load this save until its object links can be read correctly.

HND02/ERROR.title: Unused object links are inconsistent
HND02/ERROR.meaning: The save's list of unused object links is broken or points outside its table.
HND02/ERROR.what_to_do: Have the saved state investigated before making changes, or inspect an older save.

HND04/ERROR.title: Saved object links have invalid values
HND04/ERROR.meaning: The checker found {count} object links with invalid use counts or map numbers: {maps}.
HND04/ERROR.what_to_do: Keep a backup and share the complete report for investigation.

PRC01/FATAL.title: Saved activity state cannot be read
PRC01/FATAL.meaning: The saved camera or running activity state is incomplete or has an unsupported layout.
PRC01/FATAL.what_to_do: Keep the original, share a report, and recover matching state from backup if available.
PRC01/FATAL.load_text: Do not load until this state can be read correctly.

PRC02/WARN.title: Part of the saved state could not be checked
PRC02/WARN.meaning: The checker could not read the state following the saved activity list.
PRC02/WARN.what_to_do: Keep a backup and share the report. Confirm that the checker understands this layout before deciding the save needs repair.
PRC02/WARN.load_text: Loading may work, but review this warning and any more serious findings first.

PRC03/INFO.title: Unusual saved camera
PRC03/INFO.meaning: The save contains a temporary camera whose layout has not yet been confirmed in ordinary retail saves.
PRC03/INFO.what_to_do: Keep the report if the camera behaves unexpectedly after loading.
PRC03/INFO.load_text: This finding alone does not prevent trying the save after backup.

PRC04/INFO.title: Creeper plant growth stops after loading
PRC04/INFO.meaning: Growing creeper plants in this save: {count}. The game forgets their growth start time when loading, so they stop growing.
PRC04/INFO.what_to_do: Keep a backup if you want to preserve the plants' current appearance. The rest of the save can load normally.
PRC04/INFO.load_text: It is OK to try loading after backup; this is a cosmetic game issue.

REF01/FATAL.title: A required map is missing
REF01/FATAL.meaning: The save needs map files that are unavailable: {maps}.
REF01/FATAL.what_to_do: Supply the matching saved maps or restore the installation's original maps, then check again.
REF01/FATAL.load_text: Do not load until all required maps are available.

REF02/FATAL.title: Saved object links point outside a map
REF02/FATAL.meaning: The checker found {count} object links outside valid map storage or between valid object positions: {maps}.
REF02/FATAL.what_to_do: Do not overwrite the slot. Preserve it and investigate the links with the matching map files.

REF03/FATAL.title: Saved links point to missing installed objects
REF03/FATAL.meaning: The checker found {count} links to unused or never-used object positions in installed maps: {maps}.
REF03/FATAL.what_to_do: Keep the slot and restore map files from the installation used when the save was made.
REF03/FATAL.load_text: Do not load or overwrite this save.

REF04/ERROR.title: Saved links point to missing saved objects
REF04/ERROR.meaning: The checker found {count} links to positions that do not contain live saved objects: {maps}.
REF04/ERROR.what_to_do: Investigate these links against the maps from this archive, or inspect an older save.

REF07/WARN.title: Some linked objects could not be verified
REF07/WARN.meaning: The checker found {count} object links within map bounds but could not prove the objects are still in use: {maps}.
REF07/WARN.what_to_do: Review the uncertain map areas. These objects are unknown, not proven missing or damaged.
REF07/WARN.load_text: The save may still load; review and back up before deciding.

REF08/INFO.title: Some installed maps were omitted
REF08/INFO.meaning: This limited inspection intentionally omits {count} installed maps: {maps}.
REF08/INFO.what_to_do: Provide the matching installed maps for a complete check.
REF08/INFO.load_text: This limited check does not prove the complete save is ready to load.

LAY01/INFO.title: Original map copy matches
LAY01/INFO.meaning: The installed maps are identical to the trusted original copies supplied for comparison: {maps}.
LAY01/INFO.what_to_do: Keep the original copies with your save backups.
LAY01/INFO.load_text: These maps pass the comparison; follow the overall loading advice.

LAY02/ERROR.title: Installed maps differ from the original copies
LAY02/ERROR.meaning: The installed map files differ from the trusted copies used for comparison: {maps}. Saved object positions may no longer refer to the same objects.
LAY02/ERROR.what_to_do: Investigate the differences and restore the save's original map set before loading.
LAY02/ERROR.load_text: Investigate before loading with these map files.

LAY04/WARN.title: Original map layout is unverified
LAY04/WARN.meaning: There is no trusted creation-time copy available for comparison with these installed maps: {maps}.
LAY04/WARN.what_to_do: Choose a trusted copy of the map files from when this save was made. Missing comparison evidence alone does not prove damage.
LAY04/WARN.load_text: The save may still load; back up and review the available evidence first.
